payload.claim: The exit-code design requires the writer's two new exception types to be split such that step 1's validation refusals and step 4's lost-race cases both map to exit 1, while step 4's "any other git failure" and a failed rollback map to exit 2; the exact seam between the two exception types (which one carries "race" vs "true failure") is left to the implementer rather than spelled out structurally, though the Notes section's git-message-based algorithm makes this buildable and no witness gap was found.
